name: AdminPageTemplate
description: A condensed page template for admin interfaces with a compact header layout. Title and back button on the left, status indicators and action buttons on the right. Designed for functional admin UIs with minimal spacing.
usage: Use for admin pages that need a compact, functional header with actions
Pass action buttons via the `actions` prop - they appear on the right side of the header
Use `status` prop for inline status indicators (e.g., Tag components) next to the title
Use `asciiTitle` prop for ASCII art headers on top-level admin sections
Use `backLink` or `onBackClick` to add a back button to the header
Template handles loading and error states automatically via `loading` and `error` props
design: Uses tight padding (py-4 px-4/6/9) compared to PageTemplate's more spacious layout
Header is a single flexbox row with `justify-between` for title/actions alignment
Title and back button align to the left with `items-center`
Actions align to the right in a flex container with gap-2
Status indicator appears inline next to the title
mb-6 gap between header and content for minimal spacing
Always full-width (no maxWidth constraint) - admin pages use full viewport
No decorative accent bar - functional over presentational
Loading state shows centered spinner with header still visible
Error state shows centered error message with optional back button
accessibility: Title is rendered as an H1 heading for proper document structure
Back button includes aria-label with backLinkTitle prop
Uses semantic HTML elements (main) for proper document structure
Loading and error states maintain heading visibility for context

props.name: title
props.description: Title for the page (H1 heading or ASCII art).

props.name: className
props.description: Custom CSS classes applied to the main wrapper element.

props.name: backLink
props.description: URL for the back button navigation.

props.name: backLinkTitle
props.description: Accessible label for the back button.

props.name: onBackClick
props.description: Callback for back button (alternative to backLink, e.g., router.back()).

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions (buttons, etc.) displayed on the right side of the header.

props.name: status
props.description: Status indicator displayed next to the title (e.g., Tag component).

props.name: asciiTitle
props.description: Use ASCII art header instead of regular heading. Options match AsciiHeader component.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows loading spinner instead of content when true.

props.name: error
props.description: Shows error message instead of content when set.

props.name: loadingContent
props.description: Custom loading content to replace the default spinner.

props.name: errorContent
props.description: Custom error content to replace the default error display.
